item.title: Armed man shot and killed after entering secure perimeter of Mar-a-Lago, Secret Service says
item.description: By MICHELE L. item.title: Phan brothers seek chance at release amid fallout from State Police investigator’s fatal crash
item.description: LOWELL — The Phan brothers charged in the 2020 killing of Tyrone Phet are asking a Middlesex Superior Court judge to reconsider the bail orders that have kept them behind bars for nearly five and a half years, arguing that new allegations of misconduct by a State Police homicide detective have thrown the case off course.
